description.en: ChatGPT-style selection assistant for the chat flow: selecting text inside the conversation shows an Ask DeepSeek button that writes the selection into the composer as a Markdown quote and focuses it.
description.zh: 聊天流里的 ChatGPT 式选区助手：在会话中选中文字后浮出「询问 DeepSeek」按钮，点击即以 Markdown 引用写入输入框并聚焦，可直接追问。
